entries.claim: Under fixed one-pixel replay, 16-32 px O2M assigned-positive sets were more persistent than 8-16 px sets while rank-only exchanges accounted for a larger share of assigned-set Top-1 flips.
entries.validity_notes: Discovery evidence. Rank and set are deliberately distinct estimands; empty-set structural states are retained and excluded from undefined Jaccard/retention means.

entries.claim: Under equivalent-side kappa=0.0625 replay, 8-16 px O2M positive sets were more persistent than 16-32 px sets, while assigned-set Top-1 flips were lower and rank-only exchanges accounted for a larger share of tiny-object flips.
entries.validity_notes: Discovery evidence. Stress-contract reversal of set persistence requires joint interpretation with the continuous boundary analysis; no causal redundancy claim is made.
